name: BMC Kirpi MRAP
armament: Shielded manual ring mount with 7.62 or 12.7 mm MG
or Aselsan SARP remote weapon station
protection: V-shaped monocoque hull, STANAG 4569 Level 3; Kirpi II adds composite appliqué; cage armour on some. Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R AP and 12.7/14.5 mm can disable tyres, optics and an exposed gunner; launchers penetrate.
visual_notes: Tall, flat-sided box body on a single V-hull, 2 axles with large single tyres
4 small armoured windows and 5 firing ports per side of the troop compartment
Big near-vertical windscreen, two roof hatches, shielded gunner position at front
